title: Pistachio and Rose Ice-cream
description: Indian kulfi style Pistachio and Rose Ice-cream

ingredients.name: some chopped pistachio and rose petals to garnish

steps: Soak all the nuts and rose petals in the milk
In the meantime, whip the cream until light peak forms
Once the nuts are softer, make a fine paste
Add the paste, rose water, cardamom, protein powder and milk powder and mix them well
Transfer it into a container and top it up with some chopped pistachio and more rose petals.
Freeze it for at least 6 hours
tips: Cashews are to add more creaminess and nutty flavour and also cheaper than pistachios
Protein powder - make sure if you do use it it is either vanilla or unflavoured
Milk powder - is optional but it makes it form firm and creamy
